steps.title: First run: create the owner account (the first account becomes the owner)
Owner name and a password of at least 12 characters entered
Guided setup starts; progress is saved automatically
Final review step of setup
The dashboard before any machine exists
New machine: name it and pick a preset
System and firmware: UEFI selected; the launch preview updates on the right
CPU and memory
Disks: a second data disk added
Network: a port forward from host port 2222 to guest port 22
Display and devices
Boot order and automation
Create and start: the machine page with the live console
Take snapshot: name it
The snapshot appears in the timeline
Dashboard with a live thumbnail of the running machine
Machines list with filters and the power button
Storage: both disks, with resize, clone and attach actions
Settings: colour seed, theme, language, motion, passkeys and host facts
Power off needs both keys and a full slide
The machine is powered off
On a phone the rail becomes a bottom bar; nothing is removed
